column4: Pixel-art sprite exactly in the style, pixel size, palette and lighting of the reference image, a 1990s Build-engine game sprite, flat pure magenta #FF00FF background, no text. The SAME tramp as in the reference with EXACTLY the same colours and clothes: the same battered brown felt hat, the same red and black flannel shirt, the same faded blue jeans with the same stains, the same brown boots, the same green backpack with the guitar neck sticking up behind his shoulder. Full body, front view, feet at the bottom edge, standing perfectly still. But he has turned in the night: his lips are pursed forward into a long thin puckered tube as if whistling, far too long, like a snout of skin; his cheeks are sucked in deep under the cheekbones; his arms hang far too long, the fingers reaching below his knees, thin, with an extra joint; his head tilted a little as if listening; the beard is matted and wet at the mouth. Noisy, gritty, grainy like a scanned bad photograph, Loab-like: almost a normal person but something is wrong that you cannot name at first. Not cartoonish, not jolly, not a monster costume, no glow. His or her eyes are only two tiny pale points, one pixel each, no glow, no pupils.
